:::{#def-rate-ratio}
#### Rate ratio

In a Poisson regression model (@def-poisson-regression),
the **rate ratio** comparing [covariate pattern](logistic-inference.qmd#def-covariate-pattern) $\vx$ to covariate pattern $\vxs$
is the ratio of their [event](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event) rates:

$$\rateratio(\vx : \vxs) \eqdef \frac{\lambda(\vx)}{\lambda(\vxs)}.$$

:::
